passages.title: Digital Attention
passages.text: Although digital tools make learning faster, they also make attention more fragile. Students become better thinkers when they slow down, notice the logic of a sentence, and explain an idea in their own English.
passages.student_response: I think that digital tools are very useful, but they can make me to lose focus. In my case, slowing down helps my thinking become clearer because I can see the reason of each sentence.

passages.title: Robust Feedback for Small Educational Models
passages.text: Small educational language models can provide responsive writing feedback under privacy constraints. We evaluate whether sentence-level explanations improve revision quality, especially when learners must reason about nuance rather than translate a fixed answer.
passages.student_response: Small models are important thing because students need many informations quickly. However, feedback should not only correct grammar because students must understand nuance and logic.

passages.title: Student Paragraph
passages.text: I think that reading English articles is helpful, but sometimes I feel burden when I meet abstract words. If a tutor shows the sentence flow first, I can express my view more naturally.
passages.student_response: Reading articles gives me new ideas, but I often translate Korean sentence directly. A better method is to follow the claim first and then choose English words that match the idea.

student_writings.prompt: Explain how students can move from translation to English-first thinking.
student_writings.response: I think that English study is very important thing because it gives many informations. In my case, when I translate Korean sentence first, my English becomes awkward and the logic is weak.

student_writings.prompt: Argue whether AI feedback should correct every sentence or guide revision.
student_writings.response: AI feedback should guide revision because students need to understand why one word feels stronger than another. Direct correction is fast, but it can hide the thinking process.

student_writings.prompt: Explain why title and abstract reading is useful for high school science learning.
student_writings.response: Title and abstract reading is useful because students can see the research problem before the details. It helps them predict the structure, notice key vocabulary, and ask better questions.
